summary: Lower &&= through a reference-aware helper so the left reference/getter is evaluated once and assignment is conditional.

target.notes: Evaluate the LHS reference once and GetValue once; assign only when current value is truthy; only then evaluate RHS and SetValue. The expression result is the retained or assigned value.

caveats: Naively rewriting x op= y to x = x op y can duplicate getters/base/key evaluation.
Property setters/proxies and computed-key side effects must preserve order.

tests.name: edge logical-and-assignment skips rhs
tests.input: let calls=0; let x=0; x &&= (++calls); console.log(x, calls);
